## first install
rc 0
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh check
sudo softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container
sudo bash <W>/home/.nice-dns-install.<X>/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh snapshot
sudo rm -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo launchctl bootout system/org.nice-dns.free-port53
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/org.nice-dns.free-port53.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.loopbackalias
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.loopbackalias.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect.plist
sudo rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/start-podman /usr/local/sbin/start-podman.sh /usr/local/sbin/start-podman-root.sh /usr/local/sbin/mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo ifconfig lo0 -alias 127.0.0.53
sudo launchctl print system/com.apple.mDNSResponder
sudo bash <W>/home/.nice-dns-install.<X>/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh post
sudo bash <W>/home/.nice-dns-install.<X>/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh status
## flavour and proxy switch
rc 0
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh check
sudo softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container

sudo bash <W>/home/.nice-dns-install.<X>/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh snapshot
sudo rm -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh

## failed reinstall
rc 1
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh check
sudo softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo cat <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh
sudo test -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container
sudo cat <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container
sudo bash <W>/home/.nice-dns-install.<X>/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh snapshot
sudo rm -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo launchctl bootout system/org.nice-dns.free-port53
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/org.nice-dns.free-port53.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.loopbackalias
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.loopbackalias.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect.plist
sudo rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/start-podman /usr/local/sbin/start-podman.sh /usr/local/sbin/start-podman-root.sh /usr/local/sbin/mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo ifconfig lo0 -alias 127.0.0.53
sudo launchctl print system/com.apple.mDNSResponder
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/usr/local/sbin
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/usr/local/sbin
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/usr/local/sbin
sudo install -m 755 <SAVED> <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo rm -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh
sudo visudo -cf <SAVED>
sudo mkdir -p <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d
sudo install -m 440 <SAVED> <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container
## uninstall
rc 0
sudo rm -f <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-debug-monitor.sh
sudo rm -f <W>/root/etc/sudoers.d/start-container <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/start-container-root.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-bridge-eval.sh <W>/root/usr/local/sbin/nice-dns-fetch-bridges.sh
sudo launchctl bootout system/org.nice-dns.free-port53
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/org.nice-dns.free-port53.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.loopbackalias
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.loopbackalias.plist
sudo launchctl bootout system/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo rm -f /Library/LaunchDaemons/com.local.mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect.plist
sudo rm -f /etc/sudoers.d/start-podman /usr/local/sbin/start-podman.sh /usr/local/sbin/start-podman-root.sh /usr/local/sbin/mullvad-pfctl-disable-on-connect
sudo ifconfig lo0 -alias 127.0.0.53
sudo launchctl print system/com.apple.mDNSResponder
sudo bash <W>/src/nice-dns/mac/start-container-root.sh restore
